title: Head, Face, Sensory Feature & Expression Anatomy Authoring
objective: Implement topology-aware head and sensory-feature appearance authoring for eyes or other sensory organs, mouths/beaks/mandibles, ears, horns/antlers/tusks/crests and expression-capable structures without requiring or inventing a human face plan.

scope.purpose: Provide topology-aware head, face-equivalent, sensory-feature and expression presentation authoring over owner-supplied anatomy eligibility without becoming canonical anatomy, mechanics or live-state authority.
included: ears and other topology-eligible sensory structures
horn, antler, tusk and crest presentation
scope.completion_gate: Representative human and nonhuman head/sensory topologies can be authored deterministically as presentation proposals with unsupported/unresolved structures explicit, without requiring a human face plan or mutating canonical anatomy, mechanics, equipment, relationships or live state.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01 and MCCS-03 are completed_verified foundations and are not reopened.
Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 reconciliation after MCCS-03 contains no new rotation/interstitial override, so reduced MCCS strict order selects MCCS-05.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form/PPIA owners retain canonical identity, topology eligibility, anatomy, Form/state, mechanics and live truth.
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; MCCS-05 supplies creator-facing presentation authoring only.
PAPT/PCA retain generic asset, rig, image/style and local-production primitives.
Head/sensory authoring must remain topology-aware and cannot assume or fabricate a human face plan.
Unsupported or unresolved head/sensory structures remain explicit instead of being silently coerced.
MCCS-05 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The ui-implementation and player-species lanes remain independently governed and are not modified by this selection.
next_action: MCCS-05 is closed. Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation contains no MCCS-05-triggered rotation, so reduced MCCS strict order selects MCCS-06 — Coverings, Color, Material, Pattern, Marking & Surface-Layer Studio — as selected_not_started.
